text:
mira_j: heads-up, late-night micro-canary is showing steady p95 drift after pushing `adaptive-quant-2026-10-aq1` to 0.7% in the midnight slice. not high error-rate but tail and a couple of alloc failures.

owen_k: alloc failures meaning OOMs? which nodes?

mira_j: two alloc fail traces on node g5-mid-02, logs show 'kv cache eviction failed' and then a fallback recompile path that increases working set.

leon_p: that sounds like the cache eviction heuristic in the new quant pipeline. did the canary enable eager-kv-evict?

mira_j: yes, eager-kv-evict=on by default in that bundle. benched with short seqs; long tails probably triggered premature eviction and rehydration churn.

owen_k: mitigation plan: (1) pause further rollouts, (2) apply a targeted pin to the midnight slice, (3) repro with longer seqs and a debug variant with fallback-off.

deploybot: suggestion: `pin-version --target=midnight-slice --version=adaptive-quant-2026-09-stable --ttl=5h` or `pause-rollout --target=midnight-slice`.

mira_j: pause first. then run the extended smoke with seq lens 6k, 12k, 20k across 3 nodes and collect p95/p99, mem, and kv-evict events. opsbot?

opsbot: queued smoke: `ops smoke --bundle adaptive-quant-2026-10-aq1 --nodes=3 --seqlens=6144,12288,20480 --dur=600 --collect=mem,p95,p99,ooms,kv_evicts` ETA 9m. link: https://internal.run/smoke/3654321000-ext

opsbot: smoke complete. 6144 p95 +8% mem +5% no OOMs kv_evicts=low; 12288 p95 +28% mem +20% 1 alloc-fail kv_evicts=moderate; 20480 p95 +60% mem +48% 2 alloc-fail kv_evicts=high. logs: https://internal.run/smoke/3654321000-ext/logs

owen_k: reproduces on 20k. pin now to avoid customer impact. TTL 5h to let infra and runtime teams triage.

mira_j: executing pin through deploybot: `pin-version --target=midnight-slice --version=adaptive-quant-2026-09-stable --ttl=5h --reason=\"kv eviction churn causing alloc failures on long tails\"`

deploybot: executed: pin successful. routing reverted; weight change propagated.

leon_p: i'll produce a debug build that disables eager-kv-evict and adds a conservative rehydrate backoff. will include long-tail perf snapshots and a reproducer harness.

ownen_k: also add a small release-note internal blurb: "Paused limited midnight canary for adaptive-quant-2026-10-aq1 due to long-tail memory churn; reverted to stable while a conservative kv eviction fix is prepared." won't publish externally until patch validated.

mira_j: opsbot, subscribe to kv_evict alerts and alloc failures for midnight slice. escalate to @oncall if alloc-fails >0 or p95 > baseline *1.25 for 15m.

opsbot: subscribed. will alert on those conditions. closing thread; pin TTL 5h.
